en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abdul Malik Bin Utba Al Hashimy who said,

‘I asked Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> about the old man and the old woman whom are weakened from the Fasting during the Month of Ramazan. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘They should give in charity every day with a handful of wheat’.
en.sarwar: 2. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ‘Abd al-Malik ibn ‘Utbah al- Hashimiy who has said the following:

“I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of an old man and an old woman who are very weak for fasting in the month of Ramadan. He (the Imam) said, ‘They pay a ransom of one mud (a certain measurement) of wheat for every day.’”
